import sys, random, time, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'.'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.learners.hittingset import enumerate_minimal_clauses
rng=random.Random(2)
best=0; bestcfg=None
for trial in range(4000):
    P=32; m=8; u=8; width=4
    T=[]
    for i in range(P):
        k=rng.randint(1,m-1); bits=rng.sample(range(m),k)
        v=0
        for b in bits: v|=1<<b
        T.append(v)
    U=[]
    for i in range(P):
        k=rng.randint(1,u-1); bits=rng.sample(range(u),k)
        v=0
        for b in bits: v|=1<<b
        U.append(v)
    got=enumerate_minimal_clauses(T,U,width,m,u)
    if len(got)>best:
        best=len(got); bestcfg=(T,U)
print('max clauses (m=8,u=8,P=32,width=4):',best)
T,U=bestcfg
m2=10000
T2=[]
for v in T:
    nv=0
    for r in range(m):
        if (v>>r)&1:
            for rep in range(1250): nv |= 1 << (r*1250+rep)
    T2.append(nv)
U2=[]
for v in U:
    nv=0
    for r in range(u):
        if (v>>r)&1:
            for rep in range(8192): nv |= 1 << (r*8192+rep)
    U2.append(nv)
t0=time.time()
got=enumerate_minimal_clauses(T2,U2,width,m2,65536)
print('big-mask clauses:',len(got),'time %.2fs'%(time.time()-t0))
import json
txt=json.dumps([{'clause':list(c),'witnesses':[0]*len(c),'counterexample':0} for c,_ in got],separators=(',',':'))
print('json size of rules:',len(txt))
